findings: README, emulator mapper and VHDL FIFO fully read and Git blob verified. Domain NES FPGA cartridge with Linux/I2C bridge; duper is project name, no file/image duplicate search in these sources. FPGA RAM queue is not hash candidate indexing or content matching. Remaining420blob inventory preserved, not claiming whole repository read.

Mapper emulates incoming data via local i2c_in and outgoing append file; no fingerprinting/equality grouping. read return not checked positive before fifo ready; zero/error can still allow first byte access of allocated buffer. open O_CREAT lacks explicit mode argument; init/debugger setters declared int without return. Source only, not compiled/loaded or file-I/O executed.

VHDL FIFO bounded by2**abus_size. Simultaneous push/pop uses if/elsif priority for push, flags based on prior-cycle size, output read independent of empty. These are hardware timing semantics, require simulation/target evidence; no synthesis/testbench run. No production code adopted.

All 13 tracked PNG images individually viewed. Hardware documentation and historical screenshots contain no duplicate-search algorithm or validated duplicate-image oracle. No live website, electrical pinout, synthesis or hardware qualification claimed. 265 JPG images and 139 other blobs remain unassessed.

Eight additional small files fully read and Git-blob verified: ARM build notes, mapper/kernel Makefiles, TTY interface header, stdin hex dumper, hello-world kernel module and I2C overlay. No duplicate-search functionality. hexout returns success after negative read (no error distinction); source observation only. Driver test is load/unload logging, not duplicate-search regression coverage. MODULE_LICENSE GPL in driver source requires separate license consideration from root metadata. No build, module loading, toolchain installation or device-tree application performed.

Five more Linux bridge source files fully read. I2C init logs driver-registration failure but always returns 0; getchr returns a byte without error status, and synthetic original-body control confirms failures indistinguishable from valid 0xff. GPIO init overwrites first IRQ-request result with second and does not unwind earlier acquisitions; module init returns on later failure without releasing prior components. proc creation result unchecked, and proc read performs actual I2C read/write rather than passive inspection. NES shell ignores dup2/exec/wait status. These are source observations and one stubbed function control, not driver/kernel/device execution; no code adopted.

Main TTY source fully read. Notify uses one shared GPIO identity plus counting semaphore, not an event queue; original-body sequential control demonstrates 2 tokens with last identity49 after notifications115 then49. Runtime interleaving/data loss not tested. Receiver inner FIFO-drain loop has no stop check and consumes bt_i2c_getchr byte without error status; stuck nonempty GPIO can prevent reaching outer stop check. write_room always256, write returns transmitted prefix on send failure, console write ignores send results. kthread creation checked only for NULL, worker started before driver allocation/registration, later init failures lack worker cleanup. No kernel build/load or hardware run.

Five echo-shell utility sources fully read and Git-blob verified. They implement a command terminal, not duplicate detection. Source-only reliability observations: multiple fd!=0 checks reject valid descriptor0 and accept -1; i2c receive increments buffer pointer without a CMD_LINE_MAX bound; console output ignores failed/short writes; inner GPIO-drain loop has no stop check. cmd_exec modifies input despite const signature, formats command into fixed buffer, reads whole1024-byte chunks passed as C strings without explicit trailing terminator when full, ignores system status and returns TRUE. No commands, shell payloads, devices or threads from this repository executed. No code adopted.

Eight JPG images individually viewed. First two share monitor/circuit scene but differ in framing/reflection; adjacent web-page photographs overlap in diagrams. These are visual scene observations, not established duplicate labels, pixel-equality checks, electrical verification or image-search test results. Historical page text/ads are not current factual authority. 257 JPG images remain.
